verdict.rationale: Wave supports limited bulk actions like importing up to 10 receipts at once and bulk bank transaction auto-import/categorization, but there's no evidence of general bulk operations across invoices, customers, or other items, nor any API/automation surface to script bulk actions programmatically. missing for 10: bulk editing/deleting across invoices or customers, documented API/CLI for scripted bulk operations, evidence of bulk actions beyond receipts and bank feeds.
